# Solarda

> Safety-gated AI farm agents for smallholder farms. AI agents watch farm data and propose irrigation, nutrient, climate and
> disease actions; a deterministic TypeScript safety engine allows, modifies or blocks each one; an agronomist approves anything risky.

- [How Solarda works](/guide): roles, autonomy levels, safety verdicts, where the data comes from, scenarios and a glossary.
- [Try the demo](/login): one-click sign-in as a farmer, an agronomist or an admin.
- Source code: https://github.com/loktrishal-05/Solar-Da (MIT licence).

All farm readings in the demo are replayed from public datasets or simulated, and are labelled as such.
